# Local UI assets

These files keep the wireframe UI usable without a CDN or internet connection.

- `wired-elements.js`: Wired Elements 2.0.5 browser bundle, downloaded from https://unpkg.com/wired-elements@2.0.5/lib/wired-elements-bundled.js. MIT license in `wired-elements-LICENSE`.
- `patrick-hand.ttf`: Patrick Hand, Google Fonts v25, from https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/patrickhand/v25/LDI1apSQOAYtSuYWp8ZhfYeMWQ.ttf. SIL Open Font License in `patrick-hand-LICENSE`.

The app starts with native controls and enhances them when Wired Elements loads. No build step is required.
